title: Disaster recovery small business grant – storms and floods August and September 2022 onwards – Terms and Conditions
summary: This document outlines the terms and conditions for the Disaster recovery small business grant related to storms and floods that occurred in August and September 2022.
who_can_apply: The business or organisation must have been affected by the Eligible Disaster (storms and floods in August and September 2022).
The applicant must be a Small Business or Not-for-Profit Organisation.
The organisation must be registered with the ACNC or an equivalent State regulatory body, or be an incorporated association or co-operative.
The applicant must not have previously received and failed to repay payments sought by Service NSW, DCS, or NSW Reconstruction Authority.
what_you_need: Evidence of costs, such as financial records, photos, video evidence, or a statutory declaration.
Proof of ownership (title search and/or Certificate of Title) for assets.
Documentation regarding the business use of assets, such as financial records or statutory declarations.
Details of previous payments and any recovery actions taken by government agencies.

faqs.a: The grant provides support for small businesses and not-for-profit organisations affected by the Eligible Disaster (storms and floods in August and September 2022).

faqs.q: What types of costs can I claim?
faqs.a: Eligible costs include loss of income, repairs to buildings, replacement of damaged stock, and leasing temporary premises within the Defined Disaster Area.
Applicants must meet specific criteria, such as being registered with the ACNC or being an incorporated association, and must not have previously received and failed to repay payments.
